KOReader Patches

KOReader patches fine-tune the interface, browser, screensaver, and Project: Title styling. Apply only what you need and restart KOReader after every change.

DISCLAIMER: These user patches are community-created. Download and use at your own risk. Please read each patch's GitHub instructions and README to understand what it does. See the KOReader User Patches documentation for installation details.

Installation

  1. Create a patches folder inside your KOReader directory (skip if it already exists).
  2. Download each user patch and copy the .lua file into /koreader/patches/ without renaming it.
  3. Restart KOReader so the new patch loads.

Core Reading Patches

Essential patches for improving the reading experience.

  • 2-browser-folder-cover.lua - Add cover art to mosaic folders with optional custom .cover images and layout toggles under Settings → Mosaic & detailed list.
  • 2-browser-hide-underline.lua - Hide the "last visited" underline; enable the toggle in Settings → Mosaic & detailed list.
  • 2-browser-up-folder.lua - Move the "up folder" control into the title bar and optionally hide empty folders.
  • 2-filemanager-titlebar.lua - Add rearrangeable metadata widgets to the file manager title bar.
  • Book Receipt - Display detailed book statistics and reading metadata on-screen

UI Customization

Patches for customizing the KOReader interface and menus.

  • 2--ui-font.lua - Switch the KOReader UI font via Settings → UI font.
  • 2-menu-size.lua - Reflow menu dimensions to match your device DPI for nicer touch targets.
  • 2-disable-top-menu-zones.lua - Disable the swipe/tap hotzones so the top menu always reopens on its last tab.
  • Info Message when Opening File Manager - Display helpful notifications when accessing files
  • 2-BrowseByMetadata.lua - Adds author, title, series, and keyword browser views.
  • 2-browser-double-tap.lua - Require double-tap to open books in the file browser, preventing accidental single-tap opens.
  • 2-browser-frontlight-update.lua - Update Project: Title/Cover Browser frontlight widget in real time when frontlight is adjusted.
  • 2-automatic-book-series.lua - Automatically group books in the same series into virtual folders within the File Browser.
  • Swipe Animation - Software page-turn animation (wipe/erase effect) as a patch
  • Fancy Highlight Styles - Adds 8 new highlight and underline styles
  • Menu Breadcrumbs - Menu breadcrumbs with a full-path popup
  • Calibre Page Estimate - Page-count estimate for unopened books using Calibre data
  • Fonts Menu Link - Adds a fonts menu link to the character panel (single patch file)

Status Bar & Visual Tweaks

Patches for customizing the status bar, colors, and visual appearance.

  • 2-statusbar-better-compact.lua - Improve compact mode icons, separators, and title/author labels.
  • 2-statusbar-cycle-presets.lua - Tap the status bar to cycle through saved preset layouts (requires KOReader v2025.04.52+).
  • 2-statusbar-thin-chapter.lua - Add level-1 TOC chapter markers to the thin progress bar.
  • 2-reference-page-count.lua - Fix reference page fallback logic so page counts stay accurate.
  • 2-change-status-bar-color.lua - Change status bar read/unread colors under Status bar → Progress bar → Thickness, height & colors.
  • Change Status Bar Color - Customize status bar colors for color e-reader displays
  • Justify Status Bar - Align status bar content with proper spacing and justification
  • 2-reader-header-print-edition.lua - Impacts the page header / footer layout when reading a book.
  • Color Themes - Day/night reading themes with a curated, customizable palette
  • Kindle-Style UI - Kindle-inspired footer with chapter time and a centred clock header

Screen & Sleep Customization

Patches for screensaver behavior and sleep screen messages.

  • 2-screensaver-chapter.lua - Add %C chapter title and %P percent tokens to the sleep screen message.
  • 2-screensaver-cover.lua - Center images, refresh before sleep, and tweak night mode behavior for sleep screens.
  • Redesigned Banner Sleep Screen - Visual refresh of the default banner-style sleep screen with enhanced layout and additional data field.
  • 2-redacted-screensaver.lua - Show the current page with random words covered by black redaction bars as a sleep screen.

Advanced Features

Standalone patches for extending functionality.

  • Increase Font List - Expand available fonts by adding custom typeface options. Note: Read through the entire issue thread to locate the code snippet, copy it into a text editor, save the file with a.lua extension (e.g., 2-increase-font-list.lua), then place it in your patches folder.
  • Unified Auto Sync - Enable automatic synchronization of reading progress across devices
  • 2-update-patches.lua - In-app updater for the sebdelsol patch collection (requires KOReader v2025.04.107+).
  • KinAMP KOReader Integration - Launch KinAMP music player from KOReader's Tools menu with basic integration.
  • Cloudflare Auth - Access OPDS libraries protected by Cloudflare authentication

Project: Title — User Patches

User patches crafted specifically for Project: Title. Download manually—these are not bundled with the plugin.

  • 2-disable-unread-progressbars.lua - Hide unread progress bars in Cover Grid for cleaner cards.
  • 2-menutext-overrides.lua - Rename folders/files for display by replacing underscores and reordering leading articles.
  • 2-project-title-jpeg-filter.lua - Filter .jpg/.jpeg files from Library mode to keep grids focused on books.
  • 2-progress-bar-colors.lua - Recolor progress bars on color displays to match Project: Title palettes.

Make Your Own

Clone the 2-userpatch-template.lua starter, rename it with the correct execution-order prefix, and customize the Lua hooks for your workflow.
